users.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	token_version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN, 
	is_superuser BOOLEAN, 
	first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(20), 
	role userrole, 
	avatar_url VARCHAR(500), 
	last_login TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	failed_login_attempts VARCHAR, 
	locked_until TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	reset_token VARCHAR(500), 
	reset_token_expires TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_token_version_nonnegative CHECK (token_version >= 0)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

rider_wallets.ddl:
CREATE TABLE rider_wallets (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	balance_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_transaction_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rider_id) REFERENCES riders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_rider_wallets_rider_id ON rider_wallets (rider_id)

financial_transactions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE financial_transactions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	wallet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	transaction_type transactiontype NOT NULL, 
	amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	reference_id VARCHAR(255), 
	metadata_json TEXT, 
	status transactionstatus NOT NULL, 
	balance_after_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_by_user_id UUID, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(100), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(wallet_id) REFERENCES rider_wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_financial_transactions_idempotency_key ON financial_transactions (idempotency_key)

payout_requests.ddl:
CREATE TABLE payout_requests (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	wallet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	bank_account_last4 VARCHAR(4), 
	bank_name VARCHAR(100), 
	account_holder_name VARCHAR(255), 
	provider_payout_id VARCHAR(255), 
	provider_response_json TEXT, 
	status payoutstatus NOT NULL, 
	rejection_reason TEXT, 
	failure_reason TEXT, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(100), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	approved_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	processed_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	failed_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(wallet_id) REFERENCES rider_wallets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(rider_id) REFERENCES riders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_payout_requests_idempotency_key ON payout_requests (idempotency_key)

financials.ddl:
CREATE TABLE financials (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	rider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	shift_id UUID, 
	transaction_type transactiontype NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	balance_before NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	balance_after NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	status paymentstatus, 
	description TEXT, 
	reference_id VARCHAR(100), 
	source_type VARCHAR(50), 
	source_id VARCHAR(100), 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(100), 
	created_by_user_id UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(rider_id) REFERENCES riders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(shift_id) REFERENCES shifts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_financials_idempotency_key ON financials (idempotency_key)
